4	/**
5	 * Get overdue invoices sorted by most overdue first.
6	 * @param {any[]} invoices
7	 * @param {string} asOf Date in YYYY-MM-DD format
8	 * @returns {Array<{ number: string, customerId: string, dueDate: string, daysOverdue: number, due: number }>}
9	 */
10	export function overdueInvoices(invoices, asOf) {
11	  return invoices
12	    .filter(inv =>
13	      (inv.status === 'issued' || inv.status === 'partially_paid') &&
14	      inv.dueDate < asOf
15	    )
16	    .map(inv => ({
17	      number: inv.number,
18	      customerId: inv.customerId,
19	      dueDate: inv.dueDate,
20	      daysOverdue: daysBetween(inv.dueDate, asOf),
21	      due: balanceDue(inv),
22	    }))
23	    .sort((a, b) => b.daysOverdue - a.daysOverdue);
24	}
